item.title: How to use react-table for advanced tables
item.description: TanStack Table (formerly react-table) provides powerful table functionality with sorting, filtering, pagination, and column management without prescribing UI implementation. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented advanced table features with TanStack Table. The most effective approach is using the useReactTable hook with column definitions and data to create feature-rich tables. This method offers headless UI flexibility, allowing complete control over table rendering and styling.
